findings.what: OPT is a paid action whose stated benefit can’t be had, and it always ends in a violation. With no work in the game, OPT_WEEK adds 7 idle days every week, so the OPT is canceled with no grace at about day 91 and the graduate goes out of status, which ends their marketplace cover. The status-ending decision pushes premium processing ($2,250). In this world premium only shortens the pending period, which is the one thing that holds status open.
findings.evidence: tests/permission.test.ts 'ends after more than ninety days in all without work' pins the cancellation and usOutOfStatus. recordWages is called only from school.ts, so no job exists after graduation.
findings.suggestedFix: Either retire OPT with the career (as the O-1 was), or reword the copy and drop premium:true from the decision's action. At minimum, stop advertising 'twelve months to work'.

findings.what: report_lost accepts permits, visas and residence documents. A lost OPT stops OPT_WEEK (inForce false, returns without rescheduling), so the 90-day violation never fires and status runs to the OPT's expiry, about 12 months instead of about 3. A 'lost' Residente Temporal frees routeRefusal for a fresh grant.
findings.where: documents.ts:319-327; permission.ts:418, 320-329; Documents.tsx:64 (button shown on WorkPane permits and visas)
findings.evidence: OPT_WEEK guard `!inForce(doc, item.at - MS_HOUR)` returns without rescheduling. The status check scheduled at OPT expiry then finds no permit and puts them out of status only then.
findings.suggestedFix: Limit report_lost to physical cards (passport, license, idcard, idp), or keep a lost permit counting for status and idle days.

findings.what: The Mexican residence chain (residence, renew, settle, naturalize, citizenship.decided) can be reached from day one, because a wealthy start passes the savings test. But the player can never live in Mexico, and nothing outside the chain reads the result: residenceRefusal has no caller, and citizenOf('MX') is read only for care in Mexico. Money is paid for documents nothing uses, and the copy says it 'lets you live there'.
findings.evidence: No write to currentLocationId anywhere in src. bootstrap.ts atSchool forces New Haven.
findings.suggestedFix: Have routeRefusal('MX') require living in Mexico (or retire the rows), and record the chain in docs/UNBITTEN.md.

findings.what: Unemployment and SNAP treat every week and month as workless, though the game still pays work-study and the Summer Cabaret. A student whose Cabaret wages qualify a CT claim is paid the full benefit while working. There's no availability or student check. The UI promises a deduction for a week with work.
findings.evidence: The comment 'none is worked now, and the week is paid whole' is false while recordWages still runs from school.ts.
findings.suggestedFix: Feed the week's work-study and Cabaret pay and hours into weekBenefit and the ABAWD count, or refuse a claim while enrolled.

findings.what: Many Papers mechanics can't be reached by a new life, because it is fixed in New Haven with only school-era wages. These are Ontario Works and BC assistance, UC, JA, Desempleo, EI, the Irish, UK, Bienestar and IMSS pensions, and Social Security (40 credits can't be earned). IMSS contribute() and eiOnCheck() have no caller, so the IMSS panel never appears and EI premiums are never taken, though EiPanel says 'Premiums come from each check'.
findings.where: imss.ts:102; eiself.ts:44; PapersWorkspace.tsx:441; earnings.ts:96 (recordWages callers: school.ts only); bootstrap.ts atSchool
findings.evidence: grep finds no callers for contribute(, eiOnCheck( or recordPension( outside their definitions.
findings.suggestedFix: Ledger them in docs/UNBITTEN.md, or retire them as the scope reset did for the career.

findings.what: A police report is decorative in play. Its only reader is NY's free stolen-license replacement, which needs a NY license and living in NY. The New Haven entry added on 2026-10-09 enables a report nothing reads.
findings.evidence: policeReport is read only in licenseReplaceFee.
findings.suggestedFix: Give it a CT consumer or say it decides nothing.

findings.what: A dismissed F-1 student keeps US status (and marketplace eligibility) until the original program end plus 60 days. setStanding('dismissed') doesn't reschedule the status check, and programEnd reads the F-1's expiry. SLATE's own comment ties the 60 days to the program ending.
findings.evidence: usStatusEnds = programEnd + 60 days whatever the standing; the check stays at programEnd.
findings.suggestedFix: On dismissal, end status at the dismissal date (or with a short grace) and call scheduleUsStatus.

findings.what: Settlement and naturalization count years from the first residence ever granted, not continuous residence. renew_residence accepts a card that has already expired, because it checks status 'valid' rather than inForce.
findings.evidence: `first` is reduced over every document with a route, canceled or lapsed ones included.
findings.suggestedFix: Require continuous inForce residence, and refuse renewal after expiresAt.

findings.what: Driving and TSA rules are kept but read only by a document look's sentence: mayDrive, licenseOf, MOPED_ON_CAR, IDP and LICENSE_LANGUAGE, plus tsaAccepts and realId. The look says an ID card is 'what an American airport’s checkpoint will read' while nothing flies. The documents.ts header still says a license 'lets its holder drive'. mayDrive's 'earn one on the Papers screen' points at a tab that's gone.
findings.evidence: Only ui/looks/papers.tsx calls mayDrive and tsaAccepts.
findings.suggestedFix: Under THE ONE RULE, cut them or reword the look and the header in the past tense.

findings.what: The Irish pension Fine promises '€22 more living alone', which homepensions.ts says hasn't been kept since 2026-10-09.

SNAP passes all monthly income as earned income, interest and UI benefits included, which gives it the 20% earned-income deduction. Social Security credits count FICA-exempt work-study pay, which the return charges no payroll tax on.
findings.where: assistance.ts:382; earnings.ts:157,174 (months include interest and benefits); socialsecurity.ts:230; taxreturn.ts:407-408
findings.evidence: snapMonth(gross, earned) receives the same value for both.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep earned and unearned apart in the months record; exclude work-study from usWages.

findings.what: ResidencePanel filters out the player's own country by comparing a SLATE country id to an ISO code. A British citizen ('uk') still sees a GB row, which says 'You’re a citizen there.'
